items.label: Modern LED Black Nightstand
items.value: Enhance your space with Lazzanto's sleek nightstand, featuring a smart LED light strip. Control the lighting via cord or app, with options for timer settings, voice activation, and music sync to create the perfect ambiance

items.label: Convenient Charging Station
items.value: Enjoy a clutter-free space and easy access to power right at your fingertips! Our end table includes 2 U-S-B ports and 2 AC outlets, ensuring your phone, tablet, and other electronics are always powered up and ready to go

items.label: Long-Lasting Use
items.value: Crafted from sturdy particle board and black-coated metal, the night stands complements any decor, from rustic farmhouse to modern minimalist. Its safe, smooth edges make it ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, studies, and more

items.label: Night Stand with Drawers
items.value: Our nightstand features 2 spacious drawers and a wide, water-resistant tabletop, keeping your essentials neatly stored and easily accessible. Plus, adjustable footpads ensure easy leveling and alignment with your bed or sofa

items.label: Hassle-Free Assembly
items.value: Designed for simplicity, our bed side table includes clear instructions and all necessary hardware. Enjoy a quick and easy assembly process that most adults can complete in just 20-45 minutes
